title: Norm production II: judge-made law, scholarship and the spread of the models

5.title: The second model: judge-made law
5.text: COMMON LAW IS CASE LAW DEVELOPED BY THE COURTS SINCE THE 11TH CENTURY. The exercise class gives three steps and one conclusion. (1) THE PUBLICATION OF JUDICIAL DECISIONS BEGINS IN THE 14TH CENTURY IN THE 'YEAR BOOKS' — without publication there would be no precedent, because a court cannot follow what it does not know. (2) STARE DECISIS: EARLIER CASES HAVE BINDING FORCE. (3) APPLICATION PROCEEDS THROUGH 'DISTINGUISHING' AND ANALOGY TO NEW CASES, and that is the way norms are produced. AND THE CONCLUSION, WHICH IS THE MOST IMPORTANT THING ABOUT THE WHOLE MODEL: THE DECISION OF THE CASE AND THE CREATION OF A NEW NORM TAKE PLACE AT ONE AND THE SAME MOMENT. That is the exact opposite of the continental model, where the norm exists first and the case is subsumed under it. In common law the norm and the case come into being together.

terms.def: Distinguishing the present case from the precedent — alongside analogy, the main technique by which norms are produced in common law.

cards.q: How does norm production work in the English model?
cards.a: COMMON LAW is case law developed by THE COURTS SINCE THE 11TH CENTURY; the publication of decisions begins in the 14th century in the YEAR BOOKS; STARE DECISIS gives earlier cases BINDING FORCE; and application proceeds through DISTINGUISHING AND ANALOGY. The conclusion: THE DECISION OF THE CASE AND THE CREATION OF A NEW NORM TAKE PLACE AT ONE AND THE SAME MOMENT — the exact opposite of the continental model.

7.title: Bentham for codification and the common law against
7.text: The exercise class sets two voices against each other, and the contrast is a fine one. BENTHAM FOR CODIFICATION (General View of a Complete Code of Laws): 'A COMPLETE DIGEST: SUCH IS THE FIRST RULE. WHATEVER IS NOT IN THE CODE OF LAWS OUGHT NOT TO BE LAW. NOTHING OUGHT TO BE REFERRED EITHER TO CUSTOM, OR TO FOREIGN LAW, OR TO PRETENDED NATURAL LAW, OR TO PRETENDED LAW OF NATIONS.' And his mathematical image, worth remembering: whoever adopts, say, Roman law DOES NOT KNOW WHAT HE IS DOING — it is a FIELD OF ETERNAL DISPUTES, and it means MAKING ARBITRARY EVERYTHING IT PRETENDS TO TAKE OVER FROM IT; 'IF WE ADD TWO QUANTITIES, ONE FINITE AND THE OTHER INFINITE, IT IS A MATHEMATICAL AXIOM THAT THE SUM WILL BE INFINITE.' THE VOICES AGAINST CODIFICATION rest on the claim that THE COMMON LAW IS SUPERIOR TO CODIFICATIONS: it is CUSTOMARY LAW SHAPED OVER CENTURIES BY THE COURTS, it is CONCRETE AND FLEXIBLE, it SECURES TAILOR-MADE DECISIONS AND THEREBY FREEDOM, and it is guaranteed by JUDGES, WHO WERE REGARDED AS THE BEST LEGAL EXPERTS. To this is added DISTRUST OF PARLIAMENT. Note that both sides argue from FREEDOM: Bentham wants to reach it through the certainty of the statute, his opponents through the flexibility of the judge.

cards.q: How does Bentham argue for codification?
cards.a: 'A COMPLETE DIGEST: such is the first rule. WHATEVER IS NOT IN THE CODE OUGHT NOT TO BE LAW. Nothing ought to be referred to custom, foreign law, pretended natural law or a pretended law of nations.' Whoever adopts Roman law DOES NOT KNOW WHAT HE IS DOING — it is a FIELD OF ETERNAL DISPUTES. The image: 'if we add a FINITE and an INFINITE quantity, it is an axiom that THE SUM WILL BE INFINITE'.

cards.q: How did the English opponents of codification argue?
cards.a: THE COMMON LAW IS SUPERIOR TO CODIFICATIONS: it is CUSTOMARY LAW SHAPED OVER CENTURIES BY THE COURTS, it is CONCRETE AND FLEXIBLE, it SECURES TAILOR-MADE DECISIONS AND THEREBY FREEDOM, and it is guaranteed by JUDGES AS THE BEST EXPERTS; to this is added DISTRUST OF PARLIAMENT. Both sides therefore argue from FREEDOM — Bentham through the certainty of the statute, his opponents through the flexibility of the judge.

9.title: The English 19th century: consolidation acts and a tightened precedent
9.text: IN LEGISLATION: THE ATTEMPTS AT CODIFICATION FAILED — in CRIMINAL LAW in 1833 and again in 1878–1880; the attempt TO COLLECT AND REVISE ENGLISH STATUTE LAW AND CREATE A DIGEST OF CASE LAW failed in 1866–1880. INSTEAD, IN THE 19TH CENTURY 'CONSOLIDATION ACTS' ARE PASSED: THEY REPRODUCE THE STATUTORY NORMS AND THE CASE LAW OF A GIVEN FIELD, APPROVED BY PARLIAMENT — and the exercise adds the important note that THIS OFTEN GOES HAND IN HAND WITH A CHANGE IN THE LAW THROUGH SELECTION AND REINTERPRETATION. Consolidation is therefore not a neutral transcription. And one asymmetry worth stating: CODIFICATIONS WERE WRITTEN FOR THE COLONIES, BEGINNING WITH INDIA IN 1860 — for itself England did not want a codification, for the ruled it did. IN THE CASE LAW, by contrast, A STRICT METHOD DEVELOPED: (1) THE BINDING FORCE OF STARE DECISIS APPLIES EVEN WHERE THE RULE IS STATED IN A SINGLE JUDGMENT, on the basis of the RATIO DECIDENDI, that is, THE LEGAL RULES ON WHICH THE COURT BASES ITS DECISION; (2) NOT ONLY VERTICAL BUT ALSO HORIZONTAL BINDINGNESS ARISES — APPELLATE COURTS ARE BOUND BY THEIR OWN EARLIER JUDGMENTS; (3) STRICT CONDITIONS APPLY TO DEPARTURE (OVERRULING). In the same century in which it rejected codification, England therefore BOUND ITS OWN JUDGE-MADE LAW.

terms.def: The legal rules on which the court bases its decision — what is binding, as opposed to obiter dicta.

cards.a: CONSOLIDATION ACTS: they REPRODUCE THE STATUTORY NORMS AND THE CASE LAW of a field with parliament's approval — but THIS OFTEN GOES HAND IN HAND WITH A CHANGE IN THE LAW THROUGH SELECTION AND REINTERPRETATION, so it is not a neutral transcription. The codification attempts themselves failed (criminal law 1833 and 1878–1880, a digest of case law 1866–1880). The asymmetry: CODIFICATIONS WERE WRITTEN FOR THE COLONIES, beginning with INDIA IN 1860.

cards.q: How was the English method of precedent tightened in the 19th century?
cards.a: 1) THE BINDING FORCE OF STARE DECISIS APPLIES EVEN WHERE THE RULE IS STATED IN A SINGLE JUDGMENT, on the basis of the RATIO DECIDENDI. 2) NOT ONLY VERTICAL BUT ALSO HORIZONTAL BINDINGNESS arises — APPELLATE COURTS ARE BOUND BY THEIR OWN JUDGMENTS. 3) STRICT CONDITIONS apply to OVERRULING. In the same century in which it rejected codification, England BOUND ITS OWN JUDGE-MADE LAW.

14.title: Source: Puchta on the historical-systematic method (1840)
14.text: THE SOURCE: 'In order to trace the genealogy of legal norms up to the heights of their principles and likewise to descend from those principles to the outermost edges of their significance, it is THE DUTY OF SCHOLARSHIP TO RECOGNIZE LEGAL NORMS AS SYSTEMATICALLY INTERCONNECTED and to disclose that they are one another's condition and origin. And it is precisely in the course of this process that THOSE LEGAL NORMS WHICH ARE HIDDEN IN THE SPIRIT OF NATIONAL LAW AND WHICH CAN BE FOUND NEITHER IN THE CONVICTIONS AND ACTIONS OF THE PEOPLE NOR IN THE PRONOUNCEMENTS OF THE LEGISLATOR ARE BROUGHT TO LIGHT and made visible as A GENUINE PRODUCT OF SCHOLARLY DEDUCTION. Thus SCHOLARSHIP JOINS THE OTHER TWO PILLARS OF THE SOURCES OF LAW AS A THIRD PARTNER: THE LAW CREATED BY SCHOLARSHIP IS THE LAW OF SCHOLARSHIP.' THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT SOURCE OF THE WHOLE THIRD MODEL AND DESERVES ANALYSIS. Puchta here says three things openly: (1) scholarship does NOT MERELY DESCRIBE the norms, it BRINGS THEM TO LIGHT; (2) those norms ARE NEITHER IN THE PEOPLE NOR IN THE STATUTE — they are neither in what the school calls the Volksgeist nor in positive law; (3) and yet they are GENUINE, because they are the PRODUCT OF SCHOLARLY DEDUCTION. SCHOLARSHIP THEREBY PLACES ITSELF ALONGSIDE CUSTOM AND STATUTE AS A THIRD SOURCE OF LAW. This is precisely what is called 'CONCEPTUAL JURISPRUDENCE' (BEGRIFFSJURISPRUDENZ) — and it is at once the strongest and the most vulnerable point of the Historical School: THE LAW WAS TO GROW OUT OF THE SPIRIT OF THE NATION, BUT IN THE END IT IS PRODUCED BY THE DEDUCTION OF A PROFESSOR.

terms.def: The doctrine that new norms can be derived by deduction from a system of concepts; scholarship thereby places itself alongside custom and statute as a third source.

cards.q: What does Puchta claim about the role of scholarship in creating law?
cards.a: That it is THE DUTY OF SCHOLARSHIP TO RECOGNIZE NORMS AS SYSTEMATICALLY INTERCONNECTED and thereby to BRING TO LIGHT norms that are HIDDEN IN THE SPIRIT OF NATIONAL LAW and that can be found NEITHER IN THE CONVICTIONS OF THE PEOPLE NOR IN THE PRONOUNCEMENTS OF THE LEGISLATOR — they are A GENUINE PRODUCT OF SCHOLARLY DEDUCTION. 'SCHOLARSHIP JOINS THE OTHER TWO PILLARS OF THE SOURCES OF LAW AS A THIRD PARTNER.'
cards.topic: Constitutionalism & Norm Production III; Legal Education and Legal Professions

cards.q: Why is Puchta's position at once the strongest and the most vulnerable point of the Historical School?
cards.a: Because THE LAW WAS TO GROW OUT OF THE SPIRIT OF THE NATION, BUT IN THE END IT IS PRODUCED BY THE DEDUCTION OF A PROFESSOR — the norms scholarship 'brings to light' are neither in the people nor in the statute. This is called CONCEPTUAL JURISPRUDENCE (Begriffsjurisprudenz).

17.title: Where the ABGB travelled and where the Code civil
17.text: The exercise class puts both maps side by side, and the difference in reach is nicely visible. THE ABGB APPLIED DIRECTLY IN LIECHTENSTEIN and SERVED AS A MODEL FOR: the PRINCIPALITY OF MOLDAVIA (1817), SERBIA (1844), MONTENEGRO (1888), PARTS OF SWITZERLAND (the cantons of Aargau, Solothurn, Lucerne and Bern), TRANSYLVANIA and THOSE PARTS OF POLAND, CZECHOSLOVAKIA AND YUGOSLAVIA THAT BELONGED TO THE HABSBURG EMPIRE UNTIL 1918. THE CODE CIVIL ACQUIRED DIRECT FORCE in the course of the NAPOLEONIC WARS in the left-bank Rhenish territories of Germany, LUXEMBOURG, BELGIUM, PIEDMONT-SARDINIA and the Swiss cantons of Bernese Jura and Geneva. IT WAS ADOPTED in PIEDMONT-SARDINIA (1837), the NETHERLANDS (1838), ITALY (1865), PORTUGAL (1868) and SPAIN (1889), and further in the Confederation of the Rhine and some Swiss cantons. AND IN THE WORLD: LOUISIANA after the US purchase (1825), LOWER CANADA, that is, QUEBEC (1866), the LATIN AMERICAN STATES AFTER INDEPENDENCE — HAITI 1825, OAXACA 1827–29, PERU 1852, CHILE 1855, ARGENTINA 1871 — and JAPAN, which in the 1870s prepared drafts on the French model, BUT THEY NEVER CAME INTO FORCE. THE ENGLISH MODEL OF JUDGE-MADE LAW spread through the BRITISH EMPIRE: to the USA, AUSTRALIA, INDIA, PARTS OF AFRICA AND PARTS OF THE CARIBBEAN. THE COMPARISON THAT FOLLOWS: THE ABGB SPREAD THROUGH CENTRAL AND SOUTH-EASTERN EUROPE, THE CODE CIVIL THROUGH THE WHOLE WORLD, AND THE ENGLISH MODEL THROUGH THE EMPIRE — each by a different route: the Austrian by prestige and kinship, the French by the army and then by imitation, the English by colonial administration.

cards.a: It applied DIRECTLY in LIECHTENSTEIN. As a MODEL it served the PRINCIPALITY OF MOLDAVIA (1817), SERBIA (1844), MONTENEGRO (1888), PARTS OF SWITZERLAND (Aargau, Solothurn, Lucerne, Bern), TRANSYLVANIA and those parts of POLAND, CZECHOSLOVAKIA AND YUGOSLAVIA that belonged to the Habsburg empire until 1918.

cards.q: Where did the Code civil spread?
cards.a: It acquired DIRECT FORCE through the Napoleonic wars in the left-bank Rhineland, LUXEMBOURG, BELGIUM, PIEDMONT-SARDINIA and the cantons of Bernese Jura and Geneva. It was ADOPTED in PIEDMONT-SARDINIA (1837), the NETHERLANDS (1838), ITALY (1865), PORTUGAL (1868), SPAIN (1889). In the world: LOUISIANA (1825), QUEBEC (1866), HAITI 1825, PERU 1852, CHILE 1855, ARGENTINA 1871; JAPAN prepared drafts in the 1870s, but THEY NEVER CAME INTO FORCE.

cards.q: By which route did each of the three models spread?
cards.a: THE ABGB THROUGH CENTRAL AND SOUTH-EASTERN EUROPE — BY PRESTIGE AND KINSHIP. THE CODE CIVIL THROUGH THE WHOLE WORLD — first BY THE ARMY, then BY IMITATION. THE ENGLISH MODEL OF JUDGE-MADE LAW THROUGH THE BRITISH EMPIRE (the USA, Australia, India, parts of Africa and the Caribbean) — BY COLONIAL ADMINISTRATION.

21.title: The Historical School in Austria
21.text: The exercise class gives three concrete steps that can be used directly for the Austrian question. (1) ZEILLER'S ACADEMIC REFORM OF 1810: THE GENERAL CIVIL CODE, THAT IS, 'AUSTRIAN PRIVATE LAW', IS INCORPORATED INTO THE UNIVERSITY CURRICULUM. Note how remarkable this is: the code is taught even before it comes into force, and above all it is the first time a NATIONAL CODE, rather than Roman law, becomes a SUBJECT OF TEACHING. (2) THE THUN-HOHENSTEIN REFORM OF 1852/55: THE BREAKTHROUGH OF THE HISTORICAL SCHOOL IN AUSTRIA, in two ways — by a MASSIVE STRENGTHENING OF THE TEACHING OF LEGAL HISTORY and by PUSHING BACK NATURAL-LAW DOCTRINE. (3) THE APPOINTMENT OF JOSEPH UNGER (1828–1913) AS A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE HISTORICAL SCHOOL. Unger is a key figure for Austria: he brought German Pandectist systematics into the interpretation of the ABGB, so that Austrian private law acquired a scholarly doctrine for the first time. THE POINT OF ALL THREE: THE HISTORICAL SCHOOL DID NOT REACH AUSTRIA THROUGH BOOKS BUT THROUGH A REFORM OF THE CURRICULUM — which is, incidentally, exactly what it would not have wished to claim about itself.

cards.q: By which three steps did the Historical School establish itself in Austria?
cards.a: 1) ZEILLER'S ACADEMIC REFORM OF 1810 — the ABGB as 'Austrian private law' IS INCORPORATED INTO THE CURRICULUM. 2) THE THUN-HOHENSTEIN REFORM OF 1852/55 — THE SCHOOL'S BREAKTHROUGH: a MASSIVE STRENGTHENING OF THE TEACHING OF LEGAL HISTORY and the PUSHING BACK OF NATURAL-LAW DOCTRINE. 3) THE APPOINTMENT OF JOSEPH UNGER (1828–1913), who brought Pandectist systematics into the interpretation of the ABGB.

22.title: The models converge: the BGB and the Swiss ZGB
22.text: THE RESULT OF THE 19TH CENTURY IS A CONVERGENCE OF TWO MODELS: THE LEGAL FORMULAE DEVELOPED BY LEGAL SCHOLARSHIP ARE IN THE END CODIFIED. The scholarship that rejected codification thus supplied it with its material. THE GERMAN CIVIL CODE (BGB) OF 1896 COMES INTO FORCE IN 1900. It rests ON THE SYSTEMATIZATION OF THE HISTORICAL SCHOOL AND PANDECTIST SCHOLARSHIP and follows the so-called PANDECTIST STRUCTURE OF FIVE BOOKS: THE GENERAL PART, THE LAW OF OBLIGATIONS, PROPERTY LAW, FAMILY LAW, THE LAW OF SUCCESSION. Remember this list in order — it is the identifying mark of the Pandectist system, and its novelty is precisely that GENERAL PART factored out in front. THE SWISS CIVIL CODE (ZGB) OF 1907 COMES INTO FORCE IN 1912. It is DIVIDED INTO FOUR BOOKS with a short introduction: THE LAW OF PERSONS, FAMILY LAW, THE LAW OF SUCCESSION, PROPERTY LAW, while the CODE OF OBLIGATIONS IS A SEPARATE CODE. AND THE MOST IMPORTANT SENTENCE ABOUT IT: IT NO LONGER FOLLOWS THE IDEA OF COMPLETENESS. That is the end of one of the three original features of codification — the Swiss code expressly reckons with having gaps, which is why it also directs the judge to decide such a case as though he were the legislator.

terms.def: The five books of the BGB: the general part, obligations, property, family and succession; the novelty is the general part factored out in front.

cards.q: How did the two models of norm production come together in 1900?
cards.a: BY CONVERGENCE: THE LEGAL FORMULAE DEVELOPED BY SCHOLARSHIP IN THE 19TH CENTURY WERE IN THE END CODIFIED. The scholarship that rejected codification thus supplied its material. The GERMAN BGB (1896, in force 1900) rests ON THE SYSTEMATIZATION OF THE HISTORICAL SCHOOL AND PANDECTIST SCHOLARSHIP.

cards.q: What does the Pandectist structure of the BGB look like?
cards.a: FIVE BOOKS: THE GENERAL PART, THE LAW OF OBLIGATIONS, PROPERTY LAW, FAMILY LAW, THE LAW OF SUCCESSION. The novelty is precisely that GENERAL PART FACTORED OUT IN FRONT.

cards.q: What is distinctive about the Swiss ZGB?
cards.a: Of 1907, in force 1912; FOUR BOOKS with a short introduction (persons, family, succession, property), while the CODE OF OBLIGATIONS IS A SEPARATE CODE. And most importantly: IT NO LONGER FOLLOWS THE IDEA OF COMPLETENESS — the end of one of the three original features of codification.

24.title: The three partial amendments to the ABGB (1914–16)
24.text: For the Austrian reform the exercise class gives both the reason and the form, and both are neat. THE PROBLEM: A COMPLETE REFORM BY A SINGLE LEGISLATIVE ACT WAS NOT POSSIBLE — the Imperial Council had been inoperative since 1914. HENCE THREE PARTIAL AMENDMENTS ISSUED BY IMPERIAL EMERGENCY DECREE: 1914 FAMILY, GUARDIANSHIP AND SUCCESSION LAW; 1915 THE DELIMITATION OF BOUNDARIES; 1916 PROPERTY AND OBLIGATIONS LAW, especially DAMAGES, WARRANTY AND LIMITATION. (It is worth noting that the most extensive modernization of Austrian private law thus took place OUTSIDE PARLIAMENT, by emergency decrees in wartime.) IN SUBSTANCE IT WAS A MODERNIZATION UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF THE GERMAN AND SWISS CODIFICATIONS — ABOVE ALL BORROWINGS FROM THE GERMAN BGB and ADAPTATION TO THE STATE OF KNOWLEDGE IN CIVIL LAW. THE FINEST EXAMPLE IS § 914 ABGB. THE OLD WORDING: 'The general rules set out in the first part (§ 6) on the interpretation of statutes apply to contracts as well.' THE NEW WORDING: 'IN INTERPRETING CONTRACTS ONE IS NOT TO ADHERE TO THE LITERAL SENSE OF THE EXPRESSION BUT TO ASCERTAIN THE INTENTION OF THE PARTIES AND TO UNDERSTAND THE CONTRACT AS CORRESPONDS TO THE PRACTICE OF GOOD FAITH.' The change is small in words and large in meaning: BEFORE, A CONTRACT WAS INTERPRETED LIKE A STATUTE; AFTERWARDS, AS AN EXPRESSION OF THE PARTIES' WILL MEASURED BY GOOD FAITH. It is exactly the shift from formalism to the social that Kennedy describes.

cards.q: Why and how was the ABGB reformed in 1914–16?
cards.a: A COMPLETE REFORM BY A SINGLE ACT WAS NOT POSSIBLE (the Imperial Council was inoperative), hence THREE PARTIAL AMENDMENTS BY IMPERIAL EMERGENCY DECREE: 1914 FAMILY, GUARDIANSHIP AND SUCCESSION LAW; 1915 THE DELIMITATION OF BOUNDARIES; 1916 PROPERTY AND OBLIGATIONS LAW (damages, warranty, limitation). The most extensive modernization of Austrian private law thus took place OUTSIDE PARLIAMENT, in wartime.

cards.q: How did § 914 ABGB change and what does the shift mean?
cards.a: THE OLD WORDING: 'The general rules on the interpretation of STATUTES (§ 6) apply to contracts as well.' THE NEW: 'In interpreting contracts one is NOT TO ADHERE TO THE LITERAL SENSE but to ASCERTAIN THE INTENTION OF THE PARTIES and understand the contract AS CORRESPONDS TO THE PRACTICE OF GOOD FAITH.' BEFORE, A CONTRACT WAS INTERPRETED LIKE A STATUTE; AFTERWARDS, AS AN EXPRESSION OF THE PARTIES' WILL MEASURED BY GOOD FAITH — exactly the shift from formalism to the social.
